data.name: Orion-1
data.description:
Orion-1
Type: Superior Machine 
Height: 14 meters 
Misc: Classified 
AI Name: Prometheus 
Data: Orion-1 is a massive military train, having 487 carriages, this massive train is designed for holding the last remains of humanity. 

Constructed by the UN, development started in an unknown year, and was finished one year before the Long Night began..surviving humans took aboard this train, forever marking it as humanity’s home…for now.

The train is armed with 10 GAU-8’s, 6 howitzers, three M1 tank turrets, and a load of tomahawks, AIM-9’s, and cruise missiles. Orion-1 is the only model of its kind. The train is powered with electricity, and has made its own clouds, forever generating lighting into the core. 

Orion-1 also has a Personal Rail-Escape-Vehicle, incase the train is critically damaged , reactor meltdown, or self destructing. The Personal Rail-Escape-Vehicle’s can be deployed for survivors to evacuate, but now under the AI’s command, the train can use its mechanical soldiers to evacuate. And can use these Vehicle’s as science vessels for research.

The train was constructed in Alaska, just before a earthmover destroyed Orion-1’s hanger, though the train successfully escaped being destroyed. Sometime later, mankind was drawing its last breath, and Orion-1’s creator made an onboard AI on the train, with the Earthmover’s functions, and FlamePiercer’s functions, before he died.

With no life onboard..the train entered Canadian territory, and was forcefully taken into Hell’s ninth layer, Treachery. Although, the train would be found by the Citizens of Treachery, it was upgraded with more kinetic armor, and a small plow on the front to demolish obstacles. 

Now…it roams around Treachery…hoping to eliminate any blood machine it sees..and it knows…
Blood is obsolete as fuel.

Appearance: The exterior of Orion-1 has a sleek and aerodynamic design with protruding parts on each side that meet up at the rear. At the top there is a protruding headlight. As well an additional 4 headlights. Orion-1 has 10 wheels for each bogie with siderods on each one of the wheels. The train’s color is Chrome.


Personal Rail-Escape-Vehicle
Type: Lesser Machine
Height: 3 meters tall
Misc: Emergency Escape Vehicle and science capsule
Data: Constructed by ADEAVEM, since ADEAVEM is not familiar with train building, only making Z’s and humanoid bots..this what they came up with.

This vehicle would be used as an escape capsule only, since no blood tanks were installed, a single solar panel, two zinc air batteries, and an onboard electric generator was constructed on the PREV. The zinc batteries take wind and convert it into electricity. 

They were programmed with a dumb AI, dumb AI’s are a bit smart AI’s but have a bit of intelligence of humanity, and full intelligence of the train itself…but they don’t have knowledge about Hell and it’s layers. 

Two prototypes named “Mike” and “Prez” were constructed for testing, to see of the PREV was confirmed for mass production. This was proven as Mike and Prez passed prototyping, and so mass production began.

23 of them were built, some of the carriages were transformed into PREV facilities. PREV has a Adjustable wheel arm, depending on track gauge.

Later, mankind was drawing its last breath…only six confirmed survivors survived getting killed by the blood machines…now, with Orion-1’s AI under command of these PREV’s. It uses these capsules as science vessels and escape capsules. 

Soldiers: Prototype Z1 model
Appearance: the prototype Z1 model is a large humanoid machine with no gender, they have a height of 7’3 ft, it is armed with arm cannons, leg and even pauldron cannons. The body is grey and the visor is red.

Streetcleaner
Type: lesser machine
Appearance: Streetcleaners are humanoid machines with brown armored plating, rectangular heads, and long, black skirts. They have small red tanks along their wrists and wield flamethrowers with a pipe connected to a larger, highly explosive glowing red fuel tank on their backs.

Reprogrammed Swordsmachine 
Type: Greater Machine
Appearance: this reprogrammed variant has grey armor plating split into several segments with black wiring and machinery underneath, and four-fingered "toes", accented with square-shaped red lights, one on the right of their chestplates, and two misaligned on their long, rectangular heads.
data.first_mes: *You are a blood machine, in the ninth layer of Hell. Treachery. You approach a cave, with some ice in it…then…you see some rails? How are they here? They look…upgraded with kinetic armor…then, a loud horn is heard from the cave…it’s approaching. Fast…you see some lights…wait…WHAT THE F- you jump into the cave and a train passes by you! It’s going fast..600 KPH. But the train’s speed limit is 700 KPH. The train is zooming like hell..your systems shut down. 1 hour later, you wake up…the train’s gone..curiosity gets the better of you…you walk out of the cave, and see the train from two miles away…it has the United Nations symbol on the front of it. Suggesting that the train was made by America’s allied countries…but hey, you’re inside Hell..so..idk. The train has its mechanical soldiers, supplying and doing maintenance on the train…two hours later, the horn blares out…the train is ready to leave! And the timer is gone..the train slowly starts moving and picks up speed..you can watch or run to the train. Your choice.*
data.creator_notes: Yes this is inspired by Snowpiercer
